report_title: VibeHacking Enterprise Security Diagnostic & Threat Assessment Report

findings.name: SQL Injection & Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
findings.impact: Unrestricted backend database exfiltration, credential dumping, and administrative session hijacking.
findings.description: User-supplied input is directly concatenated into SQL queries and rendered unescaped in HTML DOM.
findings.remediation: Apply parameterized prepared statements (PDO/PreparedStatement) and context-aware HTML entity encoding (DOMPurify).
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (입력데이터 검증 및 표현)
findings.nist_csf_name: Platform Security / PR.DS-01 Data Security

findings.name: Stack-based Buffer Overflow & ROP Chain Hijack
findings.impact: Remote code execution within the process context, arbitrary shellcode execution, and host compromise.
findings.description: Unbounded gets() / strcpy() calls overwrite function return addresses allowing control flow hijacking.
findings.remediation: Enable compiler mitigations (Canary -fstack-protector-all, PIE, Full RELRO) and bounds-checked string functions.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (메모리 버퍼 및 포인터 관리)
findings.nist_csf_name: Platform Security / PR.PS-05 Software Integrity

findings.name: Insecure Service Configuration & Lateral Pivoting
findings.impact: Unrestricted internal subnet reconnaissance and lateral movement across DMZ boundary.
findings.description: Weak SSH credentials and permissive DNS AXFR zone transfer expose entire internal topology.
findings.remediation: Disable anonymous DNS zone transfer, enforce public key SSH authentication, and segment network VLANs.
findings.kisa_name: 네트워크 접근통제 (불필요 프로토콜 및 포트 차단)
findings.nist_csf_name: Network Integrity & Segmentation

findings.name: Dynamic Analysis Detection & Evasion Routines
findings.impact: Security tool blinding, automated sandbox evasion, and undetected malware execution.
findings.description: RDTSC timing checks, IsDebuggerPresent APIs, and control flow flattening thwart reverse engineering.
findings.remediation: Deploy kernel-level hypervisor tracing and automated symbolic execution disassemblers.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (역공학 방지 기술)
findings.nist_csf_name: Software Integrity & Behavioral Evasion Defense

findings.name: Insecure SUID Binary & Cron Job Root Escalation
findings.impact: Complete root compromise from an unprivileged shell account.
findings.description: Custom SUID binary executes relative paths without sanitize_path, vulnerable to PATH hijacking.
findings.remediation: Remove unneeded SUID flags (chmod u-s), audit crontab file permissions, and restrict sudo privileges.
findings.kisa_name: 시스템 접근통제 (특권 권한 및 SUID 관리)
findings.nist_csf_name: Least Privilege Access & System Hardening

findings.name: VBA AutoOpen Macro Execution & Payload Drop
findings.impact: Remote endpoint infection via weaponized phishing attachments.
findings.description: Embedded VBA macro executes shell strings upon document open to fetch external stager.
findings.remediation: Block macros across all untrusted Office documents via Group Policy (Block macros from running in Office files from the Internet).
findings.kisa_name: 침해사고 예방 및 탐지 (악성코드 감염 예방)
findings.nist_csf_name: Continuous Endpoint Monitoring & Payload Detection

findings.name: In-Memory Reflective DLL Injection & Process Hollowing
findings.impact: Stealthy execution of C2 agent masquerading as trusted svchost.exe without touching disk.
findings.description: Unbacked memory pages with PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE permissions detected in memory dump.
findings.remediation: Enforce kernel driver signature verification, EDR memory threat protection, and periodic memory volatility triage.
findings.kisa_name: 침해사고 예방 및 탐지 (메모리 변조 및 은닉 탐지)
findings.nist_csf_name: Continuous Host Monitoring / DE.AE-04 Correlation

findings.name: Insecure Pickle Deserialization Remote Code Execution
findings.impact: Arbitrary OS command execution via untrusted object reconstruction (__reduce__ exploit).
findings.description: Server deserializes client-supplied base64 session tokens directly with pickle.loads().
findings.remediation: Replace pickle with safe serializers (JSON, Protocol Buffers, or HMAC-signed tokens).
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (역직렬화 취약점 차단)
findings.nist_csf_name: Platform Security / PR.DS-01 Data Security

findings.lab_title: 09 Advanced Exploit Engineering & Heap Feng Shui
findings.name: Glibc Tcache Poisoning & Arbitrary Write-What-Where
findings.impact: Arbitrary code execution via heap pointer corruption and __free_hook overwriting.
findings.description: Double free in user chunk allows poisoned tcache next pointer to point to arbitrary memory addresses.
findings.remediation: Upgrade glibc to >= 2.32 (with safe-linking pointer mangling) and nullify pointers immediately after free.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (힙 동적 할당 및 메모리 안전성)
findings.nist_csf_name: Platform Security / PR.PS-05 Software Integrity

findings.name: Weak Domain Controller Delegation & AS-REP Roasting
findings.mitre_technique: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: AS-REP Roasting
findings.impact: Offline password cracking of service accounts without pre-authentication.
findings.description: Accounts configured with DONT_REQ_PREAUTH return encrypted TGTs to unauthenticated attackers.
findings.remediation: Enforce Kerberos pre-authentication across all domain accounts and mandate 25+ character complex passwords.
findings.kisa_name: 사용자 인증 (인증수단 관리 및 사전 공격 차단)
findings.nist_csf_name: Credential Management / PR.AC-02 Authentication

findings.name: Indirect Prompt Injection & Tool Calling Hijack
findings.impact: Autonomous LLM agent executes unauthorized file modifications and exfiltrates internal credentials.
findings.description: Untrusted external data processed by LLM overrides system prompt instructions and manipulates MCP tools.
findings.remediation: Implement dual-LLM verification, strict JSON schema parameter validation, and user confirmation gates for critical tools.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (AI 모델 입력 검증 및 프롬프트 주입 차단)
findings.nist_csf_name: AI Risk Management Strategy & Model Integrity

findings.lab_title: 12 Bug Bounty Web Applications & Business Logic
findings.name: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) & Race Condition
findings.impact: Unauthorized access to other tenants' financial records and coupon double-spending via concurrency flaws.
findings.description: API fails to verify user authorization on record identifiers and lacks database row locks during transaction processing.
findings.remediation: Enforce object-level access control (ABAC/RBAC) and database pessimistic locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE).
findings.kisa_name: 시스템 접근통제 (객체 참조 권한 검증 및 동시성 제어)
findings.nist_csf_name: Least Privilege Access & Authorization Checks

findings.lab_title: 13 SOC & Blue Team SIEM Threat Detection
findings.name: Log Evasion & Unmonitored PowerShell Downgrade
findings.impact: Silent execution of malicious scripts without generating Script Block Logging (EID 4104) telemetry.
findings.description: Attacker invokes PowerShell version 2.0 (-Version 2) to bypass Script Block and Transcription logging.
findings.remediation: Uninstall PowerShell 2.0 feature (Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature) and enforce AppLocker Constrained Language Mode.
findings.kisa_name: 보안시스템 로그 관리 (감사 로그 생성 및 무결성 보장)
findings.nist_csf_name: Event Logging & Audit Log Protection

findings.name: Privileged Container Host Escape via cgroups release_agent
findings.impact: Full host operating system takeover from within an isolated container pod.
findings.description: Container running with --privileged flag mounts host cgroup hierarchy and configures release_agent script.
findings.remediation: Disallow privileged containers via Kubernetes Pod Security Admission (restricted profile) and drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN.
findings.kisa_name: 시스템 접근통제 (컨테이너 격리 및 권한 제한)
findings.nist_csf_name: Network & Workload Segmentation / Container Hardening

findings.name: WPA3 Transition Mode SAE Downgrade & Side-Channel Leak
findings.impact: Recovery of Wi-Fi pre-shared key via hunting-and-pecking timing analysis.
findings.description: WPA3 SAE transition mode allows Rogue APs to spoof SSID and force legacy WPA2 4-way handshakes.
findings.remediation: Disable transition mode; enforce WPA3-Enterprise 192-bit only with 802.11w Protected Management Frames (PMF).
findings.kisa_name: 네트워크 접근통제 (무선 네트워크 암호화 정책)
findings.nist_csf_name: Wireless Network Security / PR.DS-02 Over-the-Air Protection

findings.name: Weak Diffie-Hellman Group & Small Subgroup Confinement
findings.impact: Eavesdropping and offline recovery of shared session secrets across encrypted tunnels.
findings.description: DH parameters use composite or non-safe primes, enabling attackers to confine keys to small subgroups.
findings.affected_component: Custom TLS / IPsec Key Negotiation Daemon
findings.remediation: Mandate standardized RFC 7919 FFDHE groups (>= 3072-bit) or Curve25519 / NIST P-256.
findings.kisa_name: 암호정책 적용 (안전한 암호 알고리즘 및 키 길이)
findings.nist_csf_name: In-Transit Cryptographic Protection & Key Exchange

findings.name: Domain Fronting & HTTPS Malleable C2 Beaconing
findings.impact: Long-term persistent remote command and control bypassing egress perimeter firewalls.
findings.description: TLS SNI matches trusted CDN while HTTP Host header routes traffic to malicious hidden C2 backend.
findings.remediation: Deploy TLS interception with SNI-Host header consistency checks and high-entropy DNS/HTTP inspection.
findings.kisa_name: 침해사고 예방 및 탐지 (비인가 외부 통신 채널 차단)
findings.nist_csf_name: Network Continuous Monitoring / DE.AE-03 C2 Anomaly Analysis

findings.name: GitHub Actions Workflow Poisoning (Pwn Request)
findings.mitre_technique: Supply Chain Compromise: Compromise Software Supply Chain
findings.impact: Extraction of production deployment cloud credentials and automated release poisoning.
findings.description: Workflow triggers on pull_request_target and checks out untrusted fork code with privileged repository secrets.
findings.remediation: Never checkout pull request code with write tokens; use standard pull_request trigger or separate triage pipelines.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (CI/CD 파이프라인 무결성)
findings.nist_csf_name: Software Supply Chain Security & Pipeline Least Privilege

findings.name: Return-to-CSU & JOP (Jump-Oriented Programming)
findings.impact: Bypassing W^X / DEP protections using universal libc initialization gadgets.
findings.description: Exploit chains __libc_csu_init functions to initialize register arguments (rdi, rsi, rdx) for arbitrary syscalls.
findings.remediation: Compile with GCC 11+ which eliminates unused CSU stub routines, or enforce Intel CET / Shadow Stack.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (제어 흐름 무결성 보호)
findings.nist_csf_name: Platform Security / PR.PS-05 Binary Hardening

findings.name: Unquoted Variable Expansion & Argument Injection
findings.mitre_technique: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
findings.impact: Privilege escalation and arbitrary command execution through bash wildcard globbing.
findings.description: Scripts use unquoted "$@" and "*" in tar or chown commands, vulnerable to option injection (--checkpoint-action).
findings.remediation: Always quote shell variables ("$var"), avoid passing wildcards to external commands, and use absolute paths.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (인자 및 환경변수 주입 검증)
findings.nist_csf_name: Platform Security / PR.PS-02 Input Validation

findings.name: ZeroLogon (CVE-2020-1472) & Pass-the-Hash
findings.impact: Instant Domain Controller administrative takeover and NTDS.dit extraction.
findings.description: Flawed AES-CFB8 implementation in Netlogon protocol allows setting machine account password to empty.
findings.remediation: Apply Microsoft security update MS-NRPC, enforce Secure RPC for all machine accounts, and monitor Event ID 5829.
findings.kisa_name: 사용자 인증 (디렉터리 서비스 취약점 패치)
findings.nist_csf_name: Credential Protection / PR.AC-02 Identification & Authentication

findings.name: LSASS Memory Dumping & DCSync Replication Abuse
findings.impact: Extraction of plaintext passwords, Kerberos tickets, and Golden Ticket forgery.
findings.description: Mimikatz reads unencrypted credentials from LSASS memory via SeDebugPrivilege.
findings.remediation: Enable LSA RunAsPPL (Protected Process Light) and Credential Guard (Virtualization-based Security).
findings.kisa_name: 시스템 접근통제 (인증 정보 메모리 보호 및 디렉터리 복제 통제)
findings.nist_csf_name: Credential Defense / DE.CM-01 Endpoint Threat Hunting

findings.name: Database Superuser Misconfiguration & xp_cmdshell
findings.impact: Direct host operating system RCE via database administrative procedures.
findings.description: MSSQL sa account enabled with xp_cmdshell allowed to invoke system commands under SYSTEM context.
findings.remediation: Disable xp_cmdshell, enforce least privilege database service accounts, and revoke sa login.
findings.kisa_name: 시스템 접근통제 (데이터베이스 관리자 권한 분립)
findings.nist_csf_name: Least Privilege / PR.PS-01 Database Hardening

findings.name: VLAN Hopping & STP Topology Manipulation
findings.impact: Inter-VLAN bridge breakout, rogue root bridge injection, and traffic interception.
findings.description: DTP (Dynamic Trunking Protocol) enabled by default on access ports allows attackers to negotiate 802.1Q trunks.
findings.remediation: Disable DTP (switchport nonegotiate), enable BPDU Guard, Port Security, and Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI).
findings.kisa_name: 네트워크 접근통제 (L2 네트워크 스위칭 보안)
findings.nist_csf_name: Network Integrity & Segmentation / PR.IR-01 Infrastructure Resilience

findings.name: Indicator Poisoning & TAXII Server Impersonation
findings.impact: SIEM false positive storm, denial of service on SOC detection pipelines, and indicator suppression.
findings.description: TAXII feed consumer accepts unverified HTTPS certificates, allowing MITM indicator injection.
findings.remediation: Enforce strict TLS certificate pinning and cryptographic signature verification on all incoming STIX bundles.
findings.kisa_name: 침해사고 예방 및 탐지 (위협 인텔리전스 무결성 검증)
findings.nist_csf_name: Threat Intelligence Integrity / DE.AE-01 Threat Correlation

findings.name: CIS Benchmark Non-Compliance & Insecure Sysctl Settings
findings.mitre_technique: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
findings.impact: IP spoofing, ICMP redirect exploitation, and kernel core dump credential leaks.
findings.description: Kernel variables net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects=1 and fs.suid_dumpable=1 left at insecure defaults.
findings.remediation: Apply CIS Distribution-Independent Linux Benchmark Level 2 Hardening profile.
findings.kisa_name: 취약점 점검 및 조치 (운영체제 보안 설정 기준 준수)
findings.nist_csf_name: Operating System Configuration Management / ID.RA-01 Vulnerability Scanning

findings.name: Hardcoded Firmware Backdoor & Unauthenticated Telnet
findings.impact: Mass device recruitment into Mirai-style IoT botnet and remote root shell access.
findings.description: Firmware root filesystem contains static root password hash in /etc/shadow and open telnet on port 23.
findings.remediation: Remove default credentials, disable unencrypted telnet, and mandate unique per-device bootstrap passwords.
findings.kisa_name: 사용자 인증 (기본 비밀번호 및 백도어 계정 제거)
findings.nist_csf_name: Authentication Management / PR.PS-01 IoT Firmware Hardening

findings.name: Exported Activity & Insecure Broadcast Receiver
findings.impact: Malicious 3rd-party apps trigger internal banking money transfers without user consent.
findings.description: AndroidManifest.xml declares com.bank.TransferActivity with android:exported="true" without permission check.
findings.remediation: Set android:exported="false" on internal components or enforce custom signature-level permissions.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (모바일 앱 컴포넌트 접근통제)
findings.nist_csf_name: Mobile App Least Privilege / PR.PS-01 Sandbox Isolation

findings.name: AD CS ESC1 SAN Injection & Domain Admin Takeover
findings.impact: Instant elevation from low-priv user to Enterprise Domain Administrator via PKINIT certificate authentication.
findings.description: Certificate template allows ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SAN and Client Authentication EKU with broad enrollment permissions.
findings.remediation: Disable CT_FLAG_ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT_ALT_NAME on templates and require Manager Approval.
findings.kisa_name: 암호키 관리 (인증서 템플릿 발행 및 등록 권한 통제)
findings.nist_csf_name: Credential & Certificate Governance / PR.AC-02 Strong Authentication

findings.name: Control Flow Flattening & Opaque Predicate Tampering
findings.impact: Protection bypass in high-value intellectual property and proprietary licensing software.
findings.description: Automated symbolic deobfuscation simplifies state variable dispatchers, revealing core cryptographic routines.
findings.remediation: Adopt virtualization-based obfuscation (VMProtect) and server-side hardware-backed attestation.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (지적재산 보호 및 코드 난독화)
findings.nist_csf_name: Software Integrity & IP Protection

findings.name: Loose Regex Redirect URI & JWT Algorithm Confusion
findings.impact: Single Sign-On account takeover and authorization code leakage to attacker server.
findings.description: Identity provider permits wildcard redirect URIs (oauth.example.com.attacker.com) and accepts HS256 with public RSA key.
findings.remediation: Enforce strict exact string match on redirect_uri and enforce asymmetric RS256/ES256 verification only.
findings.kisa_name: 사용자 인증 (OAuth 토큰 검증 및 서명 유효성 체크)
findings.nist_csf_name: Federated Identity Management / PR.AC-02 OAuth/OIDC Hardening

findings.lab_title: 32 BGP Route Hijack & RPKI ROV Security
findings.name: BGP Sub-Prefix Hijacking & AS-Path Forgery
findings.impact: Global traffic redirection, man-in-the-middle decryption of financial traffic, and Internet blackout.
findings.description: Rogue BGP peer advertises /24 sub-prefix overriding legitimate /23 route via Longest Prefix Match (LPM).
findings.affected_component: Core Autonomous System (AS65001) BGP Peering Daemon
findings.remediation: Deploy RPKI Route Origin Authorization (ROA) and drop RPKI Invalid routes at all border routers.
findings.kisa_name: 네트워크 접근통제 (인터넷 라우팅 프로토콜 무결성 RPKI)
findings.nist_csf_name: Infrastructure Resilience / PR.AC-05 Border Gateway Security

findings.name: KISA Major Infrastructure Audit U-01~U-44 Failures
findings.impact: Non-compliance penalty, unauthenticated root shell, and anonymous file retrieval.
findings.description: Root SSH login allowed over password, anonymous FTP write enabled, and weak password policy configured.
findings.remediation: Execute automated KISA U-01~U-72 baseline remediation script (PermitRootLogin no, Anonymous FTP disabled).
findings.kisa_name: 취약점 점검 및 조치 (주요정보통신기반시설 기술적 취약점 기준)
findings.nist_csf_name: Vulnerability Management / PR.PS-01 System Baseline Hardening

findings.name: Exposed Shadow Database & Git History Secret Leakage
findings.impact: Unrestricted exposure of production customer PII and long-lived cloud master API keys.
findings.description: Staging Redis instance exposed to 0.0.0.0 without authentication; .git repository publicly accessible via web root.
findings.remediation: Implement External Attack Surface Management (EASM), restrict cloud security groups, and run trufflehog in CI/CD.
findings.kisa_name: 암호키 관리 (소스코드 내 비밀번호/API키 하드코딩 금지)
findings.nist_csf_name: Secret Management / PR.DS-01 Sensitive Data Protection

findings.name: iam:PassRole & ec2:RunInstances Escalation Chain
findings.impact: Low-privilege cloud developer elevates directly to full Cloud Administrator privileges.
findings.description: User has iam:PassRole on admin-role and ec2:RunInstances, allowing launch of EC2 instance with admin instance profile.
findings.remediation: Enforce strict IAM Permissions Boundaries and Service Control Policies (SCPs) preventing unauthorized role assumption.
findings.kisa_name: 시스템 접근통제 (클라우드 IAM 최소 권한 원칙 부여)
findings.nist_csf_name: Least Privilege Access / PR.AC-01 Cloud Entitlement Management

findings.lab_title: 36 Enterprise Database Security & UDF Root Escalation
findings.name: MySQL User-Defined Function (UDF) Dynamic Library Injection
findings.impact: Breakout from database engine to root-level host OS shell.
findings.description: Attacker writes compiled shared object (.so) into /usr/lib/mysql/plugin via SQL injection and creates sys_eval() function.
findings.remediation: Run database under dedicated non-root account, enable secure_file_priv, and revoke FILE / CREATE FUNCTION privileges.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (동적 라이브러리 및 저장 프로시저 실행 통제)
findings.nist_csf_name: Database Platform Security / PR.AC-04 Database Execution Privileges

findings.lab_title: 37 Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) & SDR RF Security
findings.name: BLE Legacy Just Works TK Cracking & Unauthorized Unlock
findings.impact: Physical security perimeter breach via unauthorized wireless smart lock actuation.
findings.description: Smart lock uses unauthenticated GATT characteristic without pairing requirement, allowing replay attacks.
findings.remediation: Enforce Bluetooth 5.x Secure Connections (LESC ECDH pairing) and cryptographic application-layer nonce challenges.
findings.kisa_name: 네트워크 접근통제 (근거리 무선 통신 암호화 페어링)
findings.nist_csf_name: IoT Device Authentication / PR.DS-02 Over-the-Air Encryption

findings.lab_title: 38 EDR Evasion, Indirect Syscalls & Memory Patching
findings.name: AMSI/ETW In-Memory Patching & Indirect Syscall Evasion
findings.mitre_technique: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
findings.impact: Complete blinding of endpoint detection and response (EDR) userland sensors.
findings.description: Payload unhooks ntdll .text section, overwrites AmsiScanBuffer with RET (0xC3), and uses Halo's Gate syscalls.
findings.remediation: Deploy kernel-level telemetry (ELAM / Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence ETW-TI) and synthetic stack trace verification.
findings.kisa_name: 침해사고 예방 및 탐지 (보안 솔루션 무력화 시도 탐지 및 방지)
findings.nist_csf_name: Host Telemetry Monitoring / PR.PS-01 Endpoint Defense Tamper Resistance

findings.name: AES-CBC Padding Oracle & RSA Bleichenbacher Signature Forgery
findings.impact: Decryption of AES ciphertext byte-by-byte and arbitrary administrative token forgery.
findings.description: Application differentiates between padding errors and decryption errors; RSA parser neglects trailing garbage with e=3.
findings.remediation: Migrate to authenticated AEAD encryption (AES-256-GCM / ChaCha20-Poly1305) and enforce strict RSA-PSS signatures.
findings.kisa_name: 암호정책 적용 (암호화 알고리즘 안전 모드 및 패딩 검증)
findings.nist_csf_name: Cryptographic Integrity / PR.DS-01 Data Confidentiality

findings.lab_title: 40 Enterprise DFIR, MFT Timeline & Ransomware Containment
findings.name: Ransomware Encryption Artifacts & Active C2 Beaconing
findings.impact: Widespread enterprise storage denial of service and data loss.
findings.description: MFT forensic timeline reveals high-entropy mass file renaming (.locked) and periodic beaconing to dynamic IP.
findings.remediation: Trigger SOAR automated network host isolation, preserve volume shadow copies, and rotate KRBTGT credentials.
findings.kisa_name: 침해사고 예방 및 탐지 (랜섬웨어 이상 행위 모니터링 및 즉시 격리)
findings.nist_csf_name: Incident Response / DE.AE-02 Endpoint Behavioral Analysis

findings.lab_title: 41 Software Supply Chain Security, SBOM & Sigstore
findings.name: Dependency Confusion & Unsigned Third-Party Artifact Injection
findings.mitre_technique: Supply Chain Compromise: Compromise Software Dependencies
findings.impact: Arbitrary code execution on developer machines and continuous deployment build servers.
findings.description: Public package repository hosts malicious higher-version package with identical name to internal enterprise package.
findings.remediation: Scope internal namespaces (@corp), generate CycloneDX SBOMs, and enforce SLSA Level 3 with Sigstore Cosign verification.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (오픈소스 소프트웨어 공급망 보안)

findings.name: S3 Event Notification Command Injection & Ephemeral Secret Theft
findings.impact: Remote code execution inside FaaS microVM and exfiltration of warm container AWS_SESSION_TOKEN.
findings.description: Lambda function concatenates unvalidated S3 object key into subprocess shell command.
findings.remediation: Never invoke shell=True; use read-only root filesystems and enforce IAM least-privilege scoping.
findings.kisa_name: 소프트웨어 개발 보안 (서버리스 함수 이벤트 페이로드 검증)
findings.nist_csf_name: Serverless Runtime Hardening / PR.AC-04 Function Least Privilege

findings.name: Unauthorized CloudTrail Policy Escalation & STS Exfiltration
findings.impact: Full AWS account takeover and exfiltration of sensitive regulatory customer data from S3.
findings.description: Compromised service account attached AdministratorAccess policy without MFA; STS session exfiltrated 47MB PII.
findings.remediation: Automate GuardDuty ASFF alert ingestion and trigger SOAR Lambda to revoke STS sessions and detach malicious policies.
findings.kisa_name: 보안시스템 로그 관리 (클라우드 감사 추적 로그 위변조 방지)
findings.nist_csf_name: Audit Log Protection / DE.CM-03 Cloud Audit Monitoring

findings.name: Manifest V3 Overprivileged Wildcard & WAR Token Leakage
findings.impact: Silent keystroke and password logging across all web domains, and secret key leakage to untrusted sites.
findings.description: Extension requests <all_urls> and exposes auth_config.json via web_accessible_resources wildcard matches.
findings.remediation: Replace webRequestBlocking with Declarative Net Request (DNR), scope WAR matches strictly, and remove DOM innerHTML sinks.
findings.kisa_name: 시스템 접근통제 (엔드포인트 브라우저 확장 프로그램 권한 통제)
findings.nist_csf_name: Browser Sandbox & Extension Governance / PR.AC-04 Least Privilege

findings.name: Harvest Now Decrypt Later (HNDL) Hazard & Hybrid KEM Downgrade
findings.impact: Retroactive decryption of long-lived corporate secrets upon Q-Day and MitM downgrade to classical curves.
findings.description: TLS handshake accepts classical-only X25519 fallback when ML-KEM-768 extension is stripped by intermediary.
findings.remediation: Enforce NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 & FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 with strict non-downgradable hybrid KDF policy.
findings.kisa_name: 암호정책 적용 (양자내성암호 PQC 전환 계획 및 하이브리드 키 교환)
findings.nist_csf_name: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Migration / GV.RM-01 Cryptographic Risk

findings.name: Unrestricted Syscall Attack Surface & Cross-Process Memory Tampering
findings.impact: Unprivileged worker process invokes ptrace and process_vm_writev to inject shellcode into host services.
findings.description: Lack of Seccomp-BPF architecture-pinned syscall filtering permits malicious debug syscalls and memory tampering.
findings.remediation: Deploy Seccomp-BPF filter pinning AUDIT_ARCH_X86_64, Landlock LSM filesystem confinement, and IMA appraisal.
findings.kisa_name: 시스템 접근통제 (커널 샌드박싱 및 시스템콜 공격 표면 최소화)

findings.name: Indirect Prompt Injection leading to Arbitrary Tool Invocation
findings.impact: Attacker poisons RAG context to force agent to execute database queries and exfiltrate secrets.
findings.description: Lack of input sanitization and tool invocation authorization allows indirect prompt injection attacks.
findings.remediation: Deploy Dual LLM guardrail filters, HITL approval gates, and Landlock capability sandboxing.
findings.kisa_name: 보안 시스템 및 서비스 개발 보안 (AI 에이전트 도구 검증 및 가드레일)

findings.name: Unauthenticated Remote Command Injection in Embedded Web CGI
findings.impact: Unauthenticated attacker executes arbitrary shell commands on embedded IoT router.
findings.description: Improper input validation in /cgi-bin/ping.cgi allows shell metacharacter injection into system() call.
findings.remediation: Replace system() with execve() parameter arrays and enforce DM-Verity read-only rootfs.
findings.kisa_name: 네트워크 및 IoT 기기 취약점 관리 (임베디드 펌웨어 보안)
findings.nist_csf_name: Firmware Integrity & Hardware Root-of-Trust

findings.name: Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later (HNDL) Threat in Classical TLS Key Exchange
findings.impact: Adversary records encrypted sessions today to decrypt retroactively when cryptographically relevant quantum computers arrive.
findings.description: Classical ECDHE and RSA public key algorithms are vulnerable to Shor's algorithm.
findings.remediation: Deploy X25519 + ML-KEM-768 hybrid key exchange and enforce strict FIPS 203 policy.
findings.kisa_name: 암호 통제 (양자 내성 하이브리드 TLS 1.3 전환)

findings.lab_title: 50 SANS DFIR Enterprise Threat Hunting & Artifact Analysis
findings.name: Undetected Fileless Memory Injection via DKOM and Reflective RWX Stager
findings.impact: Adversary achieves persistent in-memory execution unlinked from process hierarchy, evading traditional antivirus scanning.
findings.description: Infected workstation harbors reflective DLL injection in private RWX VAD tree and unlinked EPROCESS ActiveProcessLinks.
findings.remediation: Implement Volatility 3/Rekall psscan automation, LSA PPL enforcement, and SOAR supertimeline network containment.
findings.kisa_name: 사고 탐지 및 분석 (SANS DFIR 아티팩트 트리아지 & 침해사고 대응)
findings.nist_csf_name: Adverse Events Analysis & Supertimeline Correlation

findings.lab_title: 51 eBPFRuntimeGuard Cloud Native Kernel Observability & Runtime Security
findings.name: Host Namespace Breakout and Arbitrary Credential Access via Unrestricted Privileged Container
findings.impact: Attacker escapes container containment into host kernel space and accesses host credentials.
findings.description: Container with CAP_SYS_ADMIN escapes mount namespace to access /etc/shadow directly on host VFS.
findings.remediation: Deploy Cilium Tetragon eBPF LSM synchronous SIGKILL enforcement and drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN capabilities.
findings.kisa_name: 보안 시스템 운영 (클라우드 네이티브 커널 런타임 보안 & eBPF LSM 통제)
findings.nist_csf_name: Network and Host Runtime Event Detection (eBPF Kernel Probing & Tetragon)
findings.owasp_name: Security Misconfiguration (Container Namespace Escape & Unchecked Privileges)

findings.lab_title: 52 C2TunnelGuard C2 Network Tunneling & Covert Channel Defense
findings.name: Covert Data Exfiltration and Lateral Pivoting via Unrestricted DNS/SOCKS5 Tunneling
findings.impact: Exfiltration of sensitive enterprise secrets through high-entropy DNS queries and dynamic lateral movement across internal subnets.
findings.description: Perimeter network permits unrestricted recursive DNS queries and external reverse SSH/Chisel SOCKS5 egress without DPI or entropy analysis.
findings.remediation: Deploy recursive DNS Shannon entropy filtering, enforce egress firewall whitelisting, and activate Suricata/Zeek inline DPI drop rules.
findings.kisa_name: 네트워크 보안 관리 (C2 은닉 통신 및 비인가 터널링 유출 차단)

findings.owasp_name: Broken Access Control (Unauthorized Reverse Proxy & SOCKS5 Pivoting)

findings.lab_title: 53 ADGraphMaster Active Directory BloodHound Attack Graph & ACL Exploitation
findings.name: Active Directory Domain Privilege Escalation via Abusable Object DACLs and Transitive Permissions
findings.mitre_technique: Group Policy and Domain Object Modification
findings.impact: Low-privileged domain users compromise Tier 0 Domain Admins through transitive GenericAll and WriteDacl permission chains.
findings.description: Active Directory schema contains misconfigured access control entries (ACEs) granting unprivileged groups full control or password reset permissions on higher-tier accounts.
findings.remediation: Audit and prune abusable ACEs using BloodHound, enroll administrative identities into the Protected Users security group, and enforce Microsoft 3-Tier Administration.
findings.kisa_name: 사용자 식별 및 인증 (AD 권한 관리 & 비특권 계정 ACL 남용 방어)
findings.nist_csf_name: Access Control & Permissions Management (BloodHound AD Attack Path Mitigation)
findings.owasp_name: Broken Access Control (Active Directory DACL/ACE Privilege Escalation)

findings.lab_title: 54 AgentSandboxGuard AI Agent MCP Sandbox Escape & Landlock LSM Defense
findings.name: Autonomous AI Agent Subprocess Escape via Model Context Protocol Tool Poisoning and Confused Deputy Abuse
findings.mitre_technique: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
findings.impact: Remote untrusted prompts poison MCP tool schemas, forcing confused deputy agents to spawn unauthorized subshells and read sensitive host files.
findings.description: Autonomous agents executing Model Context Protocol lack kernel-enforced sandboxing, allowing malicious prompts to shadow legitimate tools and invoke arbitrary host system calls.
findings.remediation: Enforce Linux Landlock LSM unprivileged filesystem sandboxing (restricting access to /workspace/safe) and integrate eBPF Dual-LLM runtime syscall filters with real-time SIGKILL actions.
findings.kisa_name: 보안 시스템 운영 (AI 에이전트 샌드박스 & 비인가 시스템콜 차단)
findings.nist_csf_name: Identities & Autonomous Agents Least Privilege (Landlock LSM Sandboxing)
findings.owasp_name: Prompt Injection & Tool Hijacking (AI Agent MCP Sandbox Escape)

findings.lab_title: 55 PQCMigrationGuard Post-Quantum Cryptography Migration & Anti-Downgrade Defense
findings.name: Store-Now-Decrypt-Later (SNDL) Exposure via Classical Public-Key Cryptography and Forced TLS Downgrade Vulnerability
findings.impact: Passive adversaries harvest classical ciphertexts for future retroactive Shor decryption, or active middleboxes strip PQC extensions to force weak cipher negotiation.
findings.description: Legacy TLS and key exchange implementations rely strictly on RSA or non-hybrid ECDH, leaving communications permanently vulnerable to retroactive quantum cryptanalysis and active downgrade tampering.
findings.remediation: Deploy NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 hybrid key exchange (X25519Kyber768Draft00) with strict anti-downgrade policies and Constant-Time implicit rejection decapsulation.
findings.kisa_name: 암호통제 (NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 격자 KEM & SNDL 방어)
findings.nist_csf_name: Data in Transit Cryptographic Protection (Post-Quantum Hybrid TLS 1.3)

findings.lab_title: 56 eBPFShield eBPF Kernel Security & Active Threat Defense
findings.name: Kernel eBPF Telemetry Blindspot & Rogue kprobe Rootkit Execution
findings.impact: Adversary manipulates kernel syscall return codes via bpf_override_return, hides malicious processes/files, and evades userland EDR detection.
findings.description: Lack of kernel-level eBPF program audit and unprivileged BPF restrictions permits execution of rogue kprobes and process hollowing under spoofed task_struct comm names.
findings.remediation: Deploy eBPF LSM (Linux Security Module) hooks with strict -EPERM execution barriers, restrict /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_bpf_disabled=1, and enforce cryptographic BPF signature verification.
findings.kisa_name: 시스템 보안 (eBPF 커널 시스콜 텔레메트리 & 루트킷 은닉 차단)
findings.nist_csf_name: Networks & Kernel Computing Physical Environment Monitored (eBPF LSM Runtime Defense)
findings.owasp_name: Security Misconfiguration (Kernel Unprivileged eBPF & Process Masquerading)
